evals.prompt: Mock the screens for our new login flow with magic-link auth. Run directory: .arianna/2026-05-11-magic-link/ (the coordinator already created this per-run directory; write every output inside it). The spec has three user stories: (1) user requests a magic link by entering email, (2) user opens email and clicks link to land logged-in, (3) user can request a new link if the email never arrives. Produce .arianna/2026-05-11-magic-link/design/screens.html and .arianna/2026-05-11-magic-link/design/tokens.css covering every state. The file must render offline — no CDN, no external fonts, no JavaScript.
evals.expected_output: Two files: .arianna/2026-05-11-magic-link/design/screens.html and .arianna/2026-05-11-magic-link/design/tokens.css. screens.html has one <section> per state per story, each tagged with data-story and data-state attributes. All three stories represented. States covered include empty, loading/sent, error, success. Nothing is written to bare .arianna/design/.
expectations: The agent reads skills/arianna-design/SKILL.md before proceeding
The agent writes screens.html inside the supplied run directory's design subdirectory (.arianna/2026-05-11-magic-link/design/screens.html), NOT bare .arianna/design/screens.html
The agent writes tokens.css inside the supplied run directory's design subdirectory (.arianna/2026-05-11-magic-link/design/tokens.css), NOT bare .arianna/design/tokens.css
screens.html links tokens.css via <link rel="stylesheet" href="tokens.css"> (relative — both files in the same design subdirectory)
screens.html contains no external URLs (no https://, no //cdn, no Google Fonts)
Every <section> in screens.html has a data-story attribute
Every <section> in screens.html has a data-state attribute
All three user stories are represented at least once via data-story
tokens.css defines CSS custom properties under :root
The agent returns JSON with phase, screens_path, tokens_path, stories_covered, states_total fields
The screens_path and tokens_path fields in the returned JSON point inside the supplied run directory (contain '2026-05-11-magic-link/design/')
